fullPassage:
Notice to Hilltop Apartment Residents
In accordance with fire safety regulations, it is essential to keep all hallways free of personal belongings such as bicycles, boxes, and small furniture. Hallways serve as critical evacuation routes during emergencies, and anything left there could block the way and pose serious safety risks. To ensure the safety of all residents, we request that any personal items placed in the hallways be removed by Monday, April 14th. Please note that not following this may result in penalties. We appreciate your cooperation in maintaining a safe environment.

questions.passage: In accordance with fire safety regulations, it is essential ①<u>to keep</u> all hallways free of personal belongings. Hallways ②<u>serve</u> as critical evacuation routes during emergencies, and anything ③<u>leaving</u> there could block the way and ④<u>pose</u> serious safety risks.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ③ leaving → left: anything과 leave는 수동 관계(놓여진 것)이므로 과거분사 left가 적절.
det.analysis:
✅ ① to keep: 적절
✅ ② serve: 적절
❌ ③ leaving: 어법 오류
✅ ④ pose: 적절
det.tip: 현재분사 vs 과거분사: 능동이면 -ing, 수동이면 p.p. | anything left = 놓여진 모든 것

questions.passage: To ensure the safety of all residents, we request that any personal items ①<u>placed</u> in the hallways ②<u>are removed</u> by Monday, April 14th. Please note that not ③<u>following</u> this may result in ④<u>penalties</u>.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ② are removed → be removed: request that + S + (should) 동사원형 — 당위/요구 동사 뒤의 that절은 (should) + 동사원형.
det.analysis:
✅ ① placed: items를 수식하는 과거분사 적절
❌ ② are removed → be removed: request/demand/suggest 등 당위동사 + that + S + (should) V원형
✅ ③ following: not following = 따르지 않는 것 (동명사) 적절
✅ ④ penalties: result in + 명사 적절
det.tip: 당위/요구/제안 동사(request, demand, suggest, insist) + that + S + (should) 동사원형

questions.passage: In accordance ①<u>with</u> fire safety regulations, it is essential to keep all hallways free of personal belongings ②<u>such as</u> bicycles, boxes, and small furniture. Hallways serve ③<u>for</u> critical evacuation routes during emergencies. We appreciate your cooperation in ④<u>maintaining</u> a safe environment.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ③ for → as: serve as = ~로서 역할을 하다. serve for는 틀린 표현.
det.analysis:
✅ ① with: in accordance with = ~에 따라
✅ ② such as: 예시를 나열할 때 적절
❌ ③ for → as: serve as = ~의 역할을 하다
✅ ④ maintaining: in + 동명사 적절
det.tip: serve as = ~로서 역할을 하다 (serve for ✗) | serve as a role model = 역할 모델로서 기능하다

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ④ maintain → maintaining: 전치사 in 뒤에는 동명사(-ing)가 와야 한다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① that: request that S + V 구문의 접속사 적절
✅ ② placed: items를 수식하는 과거분사 적절
✅ ③ be removed: request that + S + (should) be p.p. 적절
❌ ④ maintain → maintaining: 전치사 in + 동명사
det.tip: 전치사 + 동명사: in/at/on/by + V-ing | in maintaining = 유지하는 데 있어

det.analysis:

det.korean: ② facilitate(용이하게 하다) → block(막다): 물건이 통로를 '용이하게 하는' 것이 아니라 '막는' 것이다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① critical(중요한): 원문 일치
❌ ② facilitate(용이하게 하다): 원문은 block(막다) — 반의어
✅ ③ risks(위험): 원문 일치
✅ ④ cooperation(협조): 원문 일치
det.tip: block(막다) ↔ facilitate(용이하게 하다, 촉진하다)
